commits.subject: Keep credential leases inside the task's organization
commits.body:
WF-6 (prior #2): the account coordinator holds every organization's logins
and API keys in one pool, and only the per-turn policy allow-list keeps a
lease inside the task's organization. Both workflows turn a failed
resolveCredentialOrder into `allowed: undefined` with `.catch(() =>
undefined)`, which the coordinator reads as "first free account of this
provider" — any tenant's subscription.

Fix at the activity layer, so no workflow code or history changes:
leaseAccount now sends an unresolvable `missing:policy-unavailable` list for
a real provider without one (the coordinator denies it with a credential
action instead of granting), and runAgentTurn refuses a leased config home or
API-key handle that is not one of its own organization's credentials.
